Fonts

SkipperCast does not bundle or download any web fonts. Text uses Inter if it is already installed on your device, otherwise your system font.

Data attributions

Required and requested credits for data shown in the app. The full list of sources, with commercial-use status, is in the data-rights register; processing details are on sources & methods.

Data Credit Licence
Marine protected areas (ds582) California Department of Fish and Wildlife, Marine Region GIS Lab CC BY 4.0; selected, projected and buffered by SkipperCast
Kelp canopy (2016) and artificial-reef guide California Department of Fish and Wildlife Public agency data; credit CDFW
Fishing regulations California Department of Fish and Wildlife; NOAA Fisheries; eCFR Facts and links only; official text governs
ECMWF IFS and WAM forecasts Contains modified ECMWF open data. Source: ECMWF CC BY 4.0; subset, interpolated and unit-converted by SkipperCast
GFS, GFS-Wave, GEFS, WCOFS forecasts; NDBC buoys; NWS; tides; HF radar; charts; hydrographic surveys NOAA (National Weather Service, NCEP, NDBC, CO-OPS, IOOS, Office of Coast Survey, NCEI, NOS/NCCOS) U.S. public domain or CC0; credit requested
Seafloor surveys and geology U.S. Geological Survey; California State University Monterey Bay Seafloor Mapping Lab; University of California Center for Integrated Spatial Research U.S. public domain per USGS release metadata; credit requested
Sea-surface temperature (MUR) and chlorophyll (MODIS) NASA JPL (NASA MEaSUREs); NASA GSFC Ocean Biology Processing Group; NOAA CoastWatch Free use with acknowledgment
Ocean currents and some model access Weather data by Open-Meteo.com CC BY 4.0; free API terms are non-commercial
Rocky-reef habitat context (Big Sur) Pacific Marine and Estuarine Fish Habitat Partnership (PMEP) Terms under review
Historical commercial fishing effort © Global Fishing Watch, 2025. Global AIS-based Apparent Fishing Effort Dataset v3.0 CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial)
AIS vessel traffic NOAA Office for Coastal Management; U.S. Coast Guard Navigation Center CC0 1.0
Landing trip reports SoCalFishReports and the reporting landings and boats Dated facts with links; publisher retains rights in its material
Base map © OpenStreetMap contributors ODbL; tiles under the OSMF tile policy
